note: Northumbria Students' Union services that matter to new students, from the menus on mynsu.co.uk. Summaries are short descriptions of each page; the page itself has the details.

services.name: Advice Centre
services.summary: Guides and advice from NSU's Advice Team on housing, academic appeals and misconduct, complaints and fee problems.

topics.name: How to contact the Advice Team

services.name: Wellbeing
services.summary: Wellbeing drop-in sessions, a quiet wellbeing room for a break, NSU's student wellbeing guide and podcast, and where to find more support.

services.name: Rate Your Landlord
services.summary: Read and write reviews of Newcastle student landlords and homes, run with Newcastle University SU and Unipol.

services.name: Contact NSU
services.summary: Where NSU is and how to get in touch.

services.name: Cost of Living
services.summary: NSU's help with money worries in one place: the food pantry, laptop loans, and free hot water and microwaves on campus.

services.name: Food Pantry
services.summary: Food for students who need it. Book a ticket on the NSU website the day before (one per person); you just show your ticket.

services.name: Laptop Loan
services.summary: Borrow a laptop from NSU for a short time.

services.name: Societies
services.summary: Find a society to join.

services.name: Sport
services.summary: Sports clubs and other ways to play sport, on the Northumbria Sport website.

services.name: Student Voice
services.summary: Become a course rep, have a say on NSU policy, or start a project that helps students.

services.name: SABB Team
services.summary: The six elected student officers who run NSU and speak up for students.

services.name: The Studio
services.summary: NSU's podcasting studio on campus. Book a session; first-timers do a short training session first.

services.name: Green Impact
services.summary: Sustainability campaigns you can get involved in with NSU.

services.name: Jobs at NSU
services.summary: Jobs at the Students' Union.

services.name: Freshers Week wristband
services.summary: The official Freshers nightlife wristband: 10+ club nights in Newcastle with other Northumbria students, sold by Voodoo Events with NSU.
services.seasonal: Nightlife, and the page address changes every year (freshersweek26), so check the link each summer.

services.name: Events
services.summary: What's on, including events to help new students settle in and meet people.

services.name: Gigs
services.summary: Gigs at the Students' Union, with venue and accessibility information.

services.name: Habita
services.summary: NSU's student hub and bar, where you can order drinks from your table on the Student Orders app.

services.name: Greenhouse Coffee
services.summary: NSU's campus café for a coffee, a light lunch or a study session.

services.name: Campuses
services.summary: Northumbria's campuses and what NSU has at each.

services.name: All NSU services
services.summary: Everything else NSU offers, such as the binding service and Mental Health First Aid training.
